settings.heading: Three ingredients. Nothing else.
settings.body: Carbonated water, real lemon juice, sea salt. A Sicilian street drink, made the way it has always been made.

settings.items: Natural Electrolytes, Three Ingredients, No Sweeteners, Made in Sicily, Zero Sugar

settings.heading: Carbonated water
settings.body: Bubbles and nothing else. No sweeteners, no flavourings, no colour.

settings.heading: Real lemon juice
settings.body: Pressed lemon, not concentrate and not lemon flavour. It tastes sharp because it is.

settings.heading: Sea salt
settings.body: A small amount, which is where the Natural Electrolytes come from. It rounds the sourness out.

settings.heading: Three ingredients, and that is the whole list.

settings.label: Palermo
settings.heading: A drink sold on the street
settings.body: In Palermo, traveling vendors sold seltz limone e sale from carts on the corner. Lemon squeezed to order, a pinch of sea salt, water charged with gas. You drank it standing up, in the heat, and kept moving.

settings.label: Today
settings.heading: The same drink, in a bottle
settings.body: We did not improve the recipe, because it did not need improving. We put it in a bottle so you can keep it cold at home. Same three ingredients, same sharp finish.

settings.question: Is there any sugar in it?
settings.answer: None. There is no sugar, no sweetener and no artificial flavour. The only things in the bottle are carbonated water, lemon juice and sea salt.

settings.question: What makes it an electrolyte drink?
settings.answer: The sea salt. It puts sodium back in, which is what you lose when you sweat. That is why the salt is in the recipe rather than being left out.

settings.heading: Salt, lemon, water. It works because it is simple.
